dataset.title: Dataset

endDate.description: Optional inclusive end date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Omit for the latest published date.
endDate.title: End date

includeChanges.description: Add 1-month, 3-month and 1-year percentage changes to latest and snapshot records when prior values exist.
includeChanges.title: Include changes

maxItems.description: Maximum number of records to return. Large ZIP or neighborhood histories need a date range, region filter, or a higher cap.
maxItems.title: Max items

mode.description: What to return: latest values, full history, a multi-metric region snapshot, or the dataset catalog. The legacy options keep old saved tasks working with the previous wide output.
enumTitles: Latest values per region
Full monthly/weekly history
Multi-metric region snapshot
List available datasets
Legacy: search by state (wide output)
Legacy: state values (wide output)
Legacy: national market heat (wide output)
mode.title: Mode

regionIds.description: Optional exact Zillow RegionIDs (for example 102001 for the United States). If both Regions and Region IDs are set, a row must match both.
regionIds.title: Region IDs

regions.description: Optional region names or substrings: 'Austin, TX', 'Texas', 'TX', '90210', 'Harris County'. Matches region, state, city, county and metro names. Leave empty for all regions.
regions.title: Regions

snapshotMetrics.description: Metrics to include in snapshot mode. Allowed values: zhvi, zori, inventory, newListings, medianListPrice, medianSalePrice, salesCount, daysToPending, priceCutShare, saleToListRatio, marketHeatIndex, newConstructionSales. Leave empty for all 12.
snapshotMetrics.title: Snapshot metrics

startDate.description: Optional inclusive start date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Omit for the earliest published date.
startDate.title: Start date
